integrity: The all-direction statement is proved analytically from the source's harmonic-projection and great-circle frequency lemmas together with the standard support-function curvature criterion; no finite directional sample is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for convex bodies in \(\mathbb R^3\) and rotational order three. It does not classify higher-dimensional analogues or quotient the seven-dimensional parameter body by rotations. Boundary parameters may have zero curvature radius in some directions.
title: Classification of the threefold planar-projection exception in \(\mathbb R^3\)
